translations.web: He said to them, “Is the lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
translations.bsb: Jesus also said to them, “Does anyone bring in a lamp to put it under a basket or under a bed? Doesn’t he set it on a stand?
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Is the lamp brought to be put under the bushel, or under the bed, and not to be put on the stand?
